module: Auxiliary controller that drives a group of local latches (doors, hatches, tailgates, latches) made of node pairs of the same vehicle, via `obj:attachLocalCoupler`. It tracks the group state (attached, coupling, autoCoupling, detached, broken, desyncedAttached, desyncedDetached), plays the attach/detach sounds, applies an opening or closing force for a short duration, registers the couplers' break groups with `beamstate`, and publishes two electrics `<name>_attached` and `<name>_notAttached` (1/0). It is instantiated once per group, with a unique `name`.
notes: Group jbeam keys: `groupType` ("default", "autoCoupling", "manualClose", "manualCloseMultiPoint"; default "default"), `couplerNodes` (header table with columns cid1, cid2, forceCid1, forceCid2, autoCouplingStrength (40000), autoCouplingRadius (0.01), autoCouplingLockRadius (0.005), autoCouplingSpeed (0.2), couplingStartRadius, breakGroup), `soundNode_nodes` (first node), `attachSoundEvent`, `detachSoundEvent`, `breakSoundEvent`, `attachSoundVolume`, `detachSoundVolume`, `breakSoundVolume`, `openForceMagnitude` (100), `openForceDuration` (0.2 s), `closeForceMagnitude` (100), `closeForceDuration` (0.3 s), `openForceConditions` (header table: advancedCouplerControlName, requiredStates), `attachUIMessage`, `attachingUIMessage`, `detachUIMessage`, `latchTriggerElectricName`, `unlatchTriggerElectricName`.
`cid2` can be a table of several nodes only in manualCloseMultiPoint mode (otherwise only the first is used, with a logged error); the closest node is then chosen.
Node names are resolved by `beamstate.nodeNameMap`; a pair with a node that cannot be found is ignored with a warning.
Sounds are allowed only 0.1 s after the reset (avoids sounds at spawn).
Anomaly: in onCouplerAttached, the attach UI message is conditioned on `detachUIMessage` (and not `attachUIMessage`), so it only appears if both are defined.
onCouplerFound and onGameplayEvent are exported but empty; resetSounds and initSounds too.
The state is saved under the key `<name>_groupState`; setState tries to reproduce the state (attach impulse, detach or break of all pairs).

tryAttachGroupImpulse.desc: Tries to close the group again: depending on groupType, restarts the local attaches of detached pairs, triggers the `attachingUIMessage` message and a closing force of `closeForceDuration`. No effect if the group is already attached.

detachGroup.desc: Detaches all pairs of the group, triggers the opening force if all `openForceConditions` (required states of other groups) are met and displays `detachUIMessage`. Does nothing if the group is already detached or in autoCoupling.

toggleGroup.desc: Opens or closes the group depending on its state. Ignored while an opening or closing force is in progress.

toggleGroupConditional.desc: Like toggleGroup, but first checks conditions on other advancedCouplerControl controllers; if one is in the forbidden state, displays the error message and does nothing.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: handles the sound delay, the lock/unlock electrics triggers, pending automatic latches, the search for the closest cid2 node in multipoint mode, and applies the opening/closing forces.

onCouplerFound.desc: Hook from controller.lua when a nearby coupler is found; empty here.

obj2nodeId.desc: cid of the other vehicle's node.

onCouplerAttached.desc: Hook: a pair of the group has attached. Updates the state, plays the attach sound (volume tied to the force) and cancels ongoing forces when the whole group is attached.

obj2nodeId.desc: cid of the node on the other side.

attachForce.desc: In practice receives the `attachSpeed` argument from controller.lua (inferred from code); used for the sound's aggressiveness.

onCouplerDetached.desc: Hook: a pair of the group has detached. State `detached` if breakForce <= 0, otherwise `broken`; re-queues the automatic latch and plays the detach sound.

obj2nodeId.desc: cid of the node on the other side.

onGameplayEvent.desc: Gameplay event hook, empty in this controller.

reset.desc: Resets all latches to the detached state, restarts the initial attaches (`couplingStartRadius`) and re-registers the break groups.

init.desc: Builds the group from the jbeam (node pairs, sounds, forces, messages), registers the couplers' break groups, starts the initial attaches and synchronizes the state.

getState.desc: Returns the group state under the key `<name>_groupState`.

setState.desc: Tries to reproduce a saved state (attach, detach or break of all pairs).
